title: jax.lax.mul returns NaN for -inf multiplied by positive subnormal float32
author: ALinrunrun

comments.author: jakevdp
comments.body: This is working as expected: XLA uses [flush-to-zero semantics for subnormals](https://docs.jax.dev/en/latest/notebooks/Common_Gotchas_in_JAX.html#miscellaneous-divergences-from-numpy), and in floating point arithmetic, zero times infinity is NaN.
